title: Phase 0 terminal verdict: does round 3 of the domain search select a domain, or does Phase 0 end with NO VIABLE DOMAIN FOUND?

scope.one_line: ONE search round (round 3), three scouts, at most five screened survivors, adversarial review of every survivor whose G4 verdict is not FAIL, on one execution box.
scope.corpus: Public literature, dataset and repository indices reachable from this container. No private data. No paid indices.
scope.seed: Rounds 1 and 2 of this same search, already banked at artifacts/phase0/round1_domain_search.json and artifacts/phase0/round2_domain_search.json (73 candidates, 8 adversarial reviews, 0 SELECT).
scope.rungs: Not applicable - this preregistration governs a SEARCH verdict, not a scaling curve.
scope.what_this_does_not_cover: It does not cover Phase 1, Phase 2 or any scaling result. It does not license a fourth round: under this preregistration, a round-3 result with no qualifying candidate terminates Phase 0. It says nothing about whether a viable domain EXISTS in the world - only about whether this search, run to this depth under these gates, found one.

domain_selected.passes_if: count of round-3 candidates with adversarial overall_recommendation == 'SELECT' AND g2a_verdict == 'PASS' AND g3_verdict == 'PASS' AND g1_verdict == 'PASS' AND g6_verdict == 'PASS' AND G4 verdict == 'PASS'  >=  1

arms: Scout A - candidates whose manufacturer holds information destroyed by law, contract or physics (irrecoverable in principle, not merely absent).

Scout B - candidates whose generator is provably LOSSY and NOT analytically invertible, chosen against the round-2 law that an invertible generator yields a closed-form inverse that takes the whole label.
Scout C - candidates where the label is a DECISION a human or an organisation made, recorded contemporaneously, and not derivable from the artifact by any rule.

RIVAL EXPLANATION RUN AS AN ARM: every survivor must have its dumbest non-learned baseline MEASURED, not estimated, before adversarial review concludes. Round 1 and round 2 killed five candidates this way.
stop_rules: If the reader emits NO_VIABLE_DOMAIN_FOUND, Phase 0 terminates. The result is written to VERDICT.md as a finding, not as a failure, and no fourth round is run under this preregistration.
If the reader exits non-zero (artifact missing or malformed), NO verdict is reported and the failure is recorded. Absence never reads as success.
If a reviewer returns SELECT while any of its own gate verdicts reads FAIL or MARGINAL, the gate verdict is taken and the candidate does not qualify. The non-flattering reading wins.
